title: Leader, Solutions Engineer, Splunk
locations: Houston, Texas, United States of America
Dallas, Texas, United States of America
teaser: Take on the role of Solution Engineering Leader, guiding a team of pre-sales engineers to deliver innovative solutions for large enterprise clients in Energy, Healthcare, and Retail. Drive technical excellence and business impact, partnering with sales leadership to shape strategy and close high-value deals. Ideal for experienced leaders with a strong background in solution engineering and people management.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/07/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

This role can be performed remote within the US

Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not provide sponsorship.

Meet the Team

You will be leading a team of presales Solutions Engineers! These technically skilled, solutions-focused individuals build positive relationships, understand customer needs and deliver innovative, effective outcomes. Groundbreaking ideas impact everything; here that means we take creative ideas from the drawing board to dynamic solutions that have real world impact. Seize the opportunity to work with a close-knit group of forward-thinkers and technical problem-solvers, delivering impactful results.

Your Impact

Splunk is looking for a dynamic, results-driven Solution Engineering Leader to lead and inspire a high-performing team of pre-sales Solution Engineers passionate about large enterprise customers in the Energy, Healthcare, and Retail Verticals! In this role, you’ll be a critical force at the intersection of technical depth and business impact — partnering with Sales leadership to shape strategy, win pivotal deals, and help the world’s most complex organizations transform with the Splunk platform.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for someone who thrives at the pace of enterprise sales, loves building and developing teams, and gets energized by technically complex, high-stakes deals. At Splunk, we move fast, care deeply about our customers, and show up for each other — and we’re looking for a leader who embodies all three.

• Lead, coach, and mentor and foster a culture of technical excellence, customer focus, and continuous learning

• Own talent outcomes — proactively identify, retain, and develop top performers while managing performance decisively at every level of the team.

• Deliver meaningful annual performance reviews using the skill/will methodology, and partner with each SE to build and execute ambitious individual development plans.

• Attract and recruit world-class SE talent — raise the bar with every hire.

• Partner tightly with Regional Sales Managers and Account Executives to build bold territory strategies and pursue the deals that matter most.

• Oversee and participate in technical discovery, solution design, proof of concept (POC) engagements, and executive presentations

• Ensure the SE team delivers compelling, differentiated demonstrations of Splunk's platform tailored to Energy, Healthcare, and Retail use cases (e.g., fraud detection, operational resilience, OT/IT convergence, supply chain visibility)

• Lead from the front on complex, high-value enterprise deals — driving technical win strategies that differentiate Splunk and close business

• Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the Energy, Healthcare, or Retail industries — including regulatory landscape, key business drivers, and common technical challenges

• Show up as a credible inspiring leader and trusted escalation point in vertical-specific technical conversations

• Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Industry teams to influence roadmap and messaging based on customer feedback

• Align with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Channels to ensure a seamless customer journey from pre-sales through adoption

• Represent the SE organization in business reviews, forecasting calls, and leadership meetings

• Be a relentless advocate for the customer internally — translating field insights into product and process improvements that actually move the needle

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or a related pre-sales technical role

• Must have 3+ years of people management experience leading SE or technical pre-sales teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Consistent track record supporting large enterprise accounts in Energy, Healthcare, and Retail verticals

• Strong understanding of data platforms, SIEM, observability, or security operations — Splunk experience a strong plus

• Experience with networking, server, application, virtualization, big data, and web technologies.

• Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences

• Experience managing POCs, RFPs, and multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles

• Excellent communication, presentation, and executive engagement skills

• Ability to work with diverse groups of people; challenge and lead people toward their peak performance.

• Hands-on experience with Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Cloud, or ITSI/ES or Observability

• Experience working in or alongside channel/partner ecosystems

• Bachelor's degree OR equivalent experience

• Able to travel up to 30%

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $239,200.00 to $314,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

* For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

** Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.
